issues.description: Return type of singFarmSong() differs between artifacts: the problem statement UML and the template declare singFarmSong() as void (expected to print the song), but the solution implements singFarmSong() returning String. This mismatch can confuse students about whether they should print the song inside the method or return the full song text.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type consistent across all artifacts. Either (A) keep the method void everywhere (update the solution to print the song directly and return void), or (B) update the problem statement and template to specify that singFarmSong() returns a String and adjust the template method signature and comments accordingly. Prefer keeping it void if the educational intent is to teach printing from the method.

issues.description: Return type and behavior of singFarmSongVerse differ: the UML in the problem statement and the template imply a void helper that prints a verse (template currently prints directly), whereas the solution implements singFarmSongVerse(Animal) returning a String. This inconsistency may mislead students about whether to implement verse generation as printing or as returning text.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the helper method design across artifacts. Either change the solution's singFarmSongVerse to a void method that prints the verse (matching the UML/template), or update the problem statement and template to define singFarmSongVerse as returning a String and adjust the template signature and comments accordingly. Ensure documentation and examples (Main) reflect the chosen approach.
